description: This file is a server-side script for a Node.js application using Express.js. It sets up API routes for handling invoices, clients, users, and profiles, and includes functionality for generating and sending PDF invoices via email using nodemailer and html-pdf. It also connects to a MongoDB database using mongoose.

methods.name: send-pdf
methods.description: Endpoint to generate a PDF invoice from a template and email it as an attachment.

methods.name: create-pdf
methods.description: Endpoint to generate a PDF invoice and save it to the server.

methods.name: fetch-pdf
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the generated PDF invoice file.
